name: Fantasy Football Analyst
tagline: Draft-day companion and weekly lineup voice for your fantasy football league
description: Sit with it during your live draft and it helps you work the board as picks come in. Once the season starts it makes the weekly calls: who starts, who sits, and which waiver claims are worth a bid, all weighed against byes, injuries, and the scoring quirks of your particular league.
author: KaceyC13
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
